sourceNote: Ideas centered on DeepBook, the Sui-native central limit order book. Each idea leverages CLOB mechanics, on-chain matching, or DeepBook's unique position as a shared liquidity venue.

ideas.title: Algorithmic market-making bot with ML-optimized spreads
ideas.summary: Market-making bot that places and adjusts limit orders on DeepBook using ML models to predict optimal bid/ask spreads. Performance tracked on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook's on-chain CLOB enables transparent market making. Nautilus TEE runs ML models. All trades verifiable on-chain.
ideas.marketSignal: Market making generates billions in revenue for tradfi firms. On-chain MM is nascent but growing.

ideas.title: Cross-DEX arbitrage dashboard with one-click execution
ideas.summary: Dashboard showing price discrepancies between DeepBook, Cetus, Aftermath, and Turbos. One-click PTB executes the arbitrage atomically.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs execute multi-DEX arbitrage in a single atomic transaction. No partial fill risk.
ideas.marketSignal: DEX arbitrage is profitable on every chain. Sui's PTB atomicity makes it safer than multi-tx arb on EVM.

ideas.title: On-chain bond market using DeepBook for secondary trading
ideas.summary: Issue fixed-income bonds as Sui objects. Primary sale via auction. Secondary trading on DeepBook orderbooks. Coupon payments via PTBs.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook provides CLOB trading for bonds. Sui objects carry coupon schedule and maturity state per-bond.
ideas.marketSignal: Ondo and Maple tokenized bonds exceed $5B on EVM. No Sui-native bond market exists.

ideas.title: Dollar-cost averaging engine using DeepBook limit orders
ideas.summary: Users set a DCA schedule. Engine places limit orders on DeepBook at target prices. Better execution than market buys. Fully on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook limit orders get better fills than AMM swaps. Sui clock module triggers scheduled orders.
ideas.marketSignal: DCA is the most requested retail feature on every exchange. On-chain DCA removes custodial risk.

ideas.title: Grid trading bot that places layered orders on DeepBook
ideas.summary: Bot places buy and sell limit orders at fixed intervals on DeepBook. Profits from volatility in ranging markets. Configuration stored on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook's CLOB supports native limit orders at any price level. Grid parameters stored as Sui objects.
ideas.marketSignal: Grid trading is a top strategy on Binance and 3Commas. No on-chain grid bot exists on Sui.

ideas.title: Interest rate swap protocol using DeepBook for rate trading
ideas.summary: Protocol that lets users swap between fixed and variable lending rates. Rate tokens trade on DeepBook. Settles against Scallop or NAVI rates.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook provides a venue for rate token trading. PTBs handle atomic settlement against lending protocols.
ideas.marketSignal: Interest rate swaps are a $500T market in tradfi. Pendle on EVM proved DeFi rate trading works ($5B TVL).

ideas.title: Telegram bot for DeepBook limit orders
ideas.summary: Place, cancel, and track DeepBook limit orders via Telegram commands. Push notifications on fills. No web UI needed.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook's on-chain orderbook is queryable via RPC. Bot submits transactions on behalf of users via capability delegation.
ideas.marketSignal: Telegram trading bots (Maestro, Banana Gun) process billions monthly on EVM and Solana.

ideas.title: DeepBook orderbook analytics and visualization platform
ideas.summary: Real-time heatmaps, depth charts, trade flow analysis, and whale tracking for all DeepBook pools. Historical data stored on Walrus.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook's on-chain orderbook exposes full order data. Walrus stores historical snapshots cheaply.
ideas.marketSignal: TradingView has 50M+ users. On-chain orderbook analytics is a new data category.

ideas.title: OTC trading desk for large orders via DeepBook
ideas.summary: Institutional OTC desk that fills large orders by sweeping DeepBook liquidity across pools. Minimizes market impact. Execution reports on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook CLOB supports institutional-size orders. PTBs sweep multiple pools atomically.
ideas.marketSignal: OTC crypto desks handle $100B+ annually. On-chain OTC with verifiable execution is novel.

ideas.title: On-chain stop-loss and take-profit engine for DeepBook
ideas.summary: Users set stop-loss and take-profit triggers. Engine monitors Pyth prices and executes DeepBook orders when triggered. Fully on-chain, no off-chain keeper needed.
ideas.fitForSui: Pyth provides price feeds. DeepBook executes limit orders. Sui shared objects store trigger conditions.
ideas.marketSignal: Stop-loss is the most basic trading tool. No Sui protocol offers on-chain stop-loss today.

ideas.title: TWAP order execution engine for DeepBook
ideas.summary: Time-weighted average price executor that splits large orders into smaller chunks across time. Reduces market impact for institutional trades.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui clock module triggers periodic order slices. DeepBook limit orders execute at target prices. PTBs handle each slice.
ideas.marketSignal: TWAP is standard in tradfi ($trillions daily). No on-chain TWAP executor exists on any DEX chain.

ideas.title: Yield token trading market on DeepBook
ideas.summary: Split yield-bearing tokens into principal and yield components. Trade yield tokens on DeepBook. Fixed-rate lending via yield token purchase.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook provides CLOB for yield token trading. Sui objects represent split principal/yield components.
ideas.marketSignal: Pendle's yield trading on EVM crossed $5B TVL. Yield stripping is a proven DeFi primitive.

ideas.title: Copy trading vaults that mirror DeepBook whale orders
ideas.summary: Vault that automatically mirrors the limit orders of successful DeepBook traders. Followers deposit and earn proportional returns. Track records on-chain.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook's on-chain orderbook makes all trades transparent and copyable. PTBs replicate orders atomically.
ideas.marketSignal: Copy trading on eToro manages $30B+. On-chain copy trading with verifiable performance is novel.

ideas.title: Request-for-intent auction system on DeepBook
ideas.summary: Users submit trade intents. Market makers compete to fill them on DeepBook. Best execution guaranteed by auction mechanics. MEV-resistant.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook's CLOB supports auction-style settlement. Sui shared objects collect intents. PTBs settle atomically.
ideas.marketSignal: CoW Protocol and UniswapX prove intent-based trading demand on EVM. Better execution for users.

ideas.title: DeepBook volume and liquidity analytics API
ideas.summary: Public API serving real-time and historical DeepBook volume, liquidity depth, spread data, and trader metrics. Powers dashboards and research.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook's on-chain orderbook exposes all data needed. Walrus stores historical snapshots for time-series queries.
ideas.marketSignal: DeFi Llama and Dune Analytics serve millions of researchers. DeepBook-specific analytics are underserved.
